items.name: Cancelled
items.summary: Used to signal that all the tasks should be cancelled.

items.name: TaskHeap
items.summary: A heap of tasks, where `K` represents the priority of the task and `V` represents the task. Add tasks with `push_lifo` and `push_fifo`, and process them with `work`.

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<T: IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>>(iter: T) -> Self

methods.name: push
methods.signature: fn push(&self, k: K, v: V, is_lifo: bool)
methods.summary: Push a task into the heap with specified ordering. If `is_lifo` is true, the task will be processed in LIFO order for equal values of `K`. If `is_lifo` is false, the task will be processed in FIFO order for equal values of `K`.

methods.name: push_fifo
methods.signature: fn push_fifo(&self, k: K, v: V)
methods.summary: Push a task into the heap. For equal values of `K`, the task will be processed in FIFO order.

methods.name: push_lifo
methods.signature: fn push_lifo(&self, k: K, v: V)
methods.summary: Push a task into the heap. For equal values of `K`, the task will be processed in LIFO order.

methods.name: reset_cancellation
methods.summary: Replace the cancellation handle with a fresh one, so that a previously cancelled TaskHeap can process work again. The old handle becomes orphaned.

methods.name: work
methods.signature: fn work(&self, f: impl FnMut(K, V)) -> Result<(), Cancelled>
methods.summary: Process items in the heap, in order of decreasing `K`. Continues processing successive items until all items have been processed, and there are no active calls to any `f` from all `work` calls.

methods.name: work_without_cancellation
methods.signature: fn work_without_cancellation(&self, f: impl FnMut(K, V))
